title: Preparing primary T cells for fluorescence microscopy
author: Bulent Arman Aksoy
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vede3a6

steps.title: Collect and wash T cells
steps.instruction: Collect and wash primary T cells using standard tissue culture techniques.

substeps.instruction: Collect 200K to 1 million cells and spin at 300g for 00:05:00
Discard the supernatant
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL PBS
Spin at 300g for 00:05:00 and discard the supernatant

steps.title: Fix the cells
steps.instruction: Fix the cells based on their clumping state.

substeps.instruction: If cells are too clumpy: resuspend in 750 µL PBS, mix thoroughly until no clumps remain, and add 250 µL of 16% formaldehyde on top
If no cell clumps are present: resuspend cells in 1 mL of Cytofix solution

steps.title: Incubate fixed cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at 4 °C for 00:30:00 on a nutating mixer (e.g., Fisherbrand™ Nutrating Mixers - Variable Speed, 88-861-043).

steps.title: Permeabilize and stain cells
steps.instruction: Permeabilize the cells and optionally apply stains or dyes.

substeps.instruction: Spin the cells at 300g for 00:05:00
Discard the supernatant
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of 1X CytoPerm Wash Buffer
Optionally, add stains or dyes (e.g., phalloidin stain) into the permeabilization buffer
Cover the tubes with aluminum foil
Incubate at 25 °C (Room temperature) for 00:30:00 (or the specific duration required for the stain) on a nutating mixer (e.g., Fisherbrand™ Nutrating Mixers - Variable Speed, 88-861-043)

steps.title: Wash and concentrate cells
steps.instruction: Perform final washes to prepare the cell suspension for cytospinning.

substeps.instruction: Spin the cells at 300g for 00:05:00
Discard the supernatant
Resuspend in 1 mL of PBS
Spin the cells at 300g for 00:05:00
Discard the supernatant
Resuspend in 200 µL of PBS

steps.title: Cytospin and mount sample
steps.instruction: Deposit the cells onto a slide and mount for microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Cytospin 200 µL of the stained cell suspension onto a glass slide or sample cover slip at 300-500g for 00:05:00
Mount the sample between a glass slide and cover slip using one drop (at least 10 uL) of ProLong Anti-fade reagent
Keep the slide within a dark container for at least 12:00:00
